The '''Spefik system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spefik]], site of a [[Spefik base|Rebel base]].<ref name="RoC" />
